retrievalProfile.description: A high-angle fashion portrait featuring a central, vertically elongated and wave-distorted outlined title overlaying a textured knit garment.
triggerTerms: overhead fashion portrait with knit texture

recipe.visualDefinition: A top-down photograph of a subject lying on rumpled sheets, wearing a chunky blue knit sweater, dominated by a large, central, vertically-stretched title rendered in a pink outline with a liquid-like wave distortion.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the soft, organic folds of the bedding and the sharp, geometric knit pattern.
Interaction between the pink outlined text and the blue sweater background.
Vertical alignment of the distorted central text against the diagonal orientation of the subject.
coreInvariants: Visible film grain and slight color desaturation
Vertically elongated typography with a sine-wave distortion

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned diagonally across the frame, filling approximately 70% of the space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central wavy outlined text serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face in the lower left, follows the diagonal line of the body upward, and settles on the central distorted text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, filled with the texture of rumpled white bedding.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted blue from the knit sweater.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white from the bedding and skin tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale pastel pink used for the primary text outline.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low to medium saturation with a crushed black point, creating a vintage film look.

letterConstructionRules: Continuous uniform stroke weight for outlines
Horizontal sine-wave distortion applied across the entire word block
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are hollow, defined only by a thin exterior boundary line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between large, fluid, outlined display type and small, rigid, solid metadata type.
graphicDevices: Small numerical technical codes in corners

avoid: Solid color fills for display text

candidateDirections.reason: Good base skeleton for vertical stretching and warping.
To achieve the specific liquid wave effect without font limitations.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a top-down photograph of a blonde woman lying diagonally on rumpled white bedding, wearing a thick, oversized blue crochet knit sweater with visible holes. Apply a heavy film grain and a slightly desaturated vintage color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large central title in a thin pink outline. Stretch the letters vertically and apply a horizontal sine-wave distortion. Add small, white, bold sans-serif metadata text along the top and right edges, separated by thin white lines.

verificationChecks: Is the central text outlined in pink?
Does the text have a wavy, liquid distortion?
Is the background a high-angle shot of a knit texture?
Are there small technical text elements in the corners?

mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles

avoid: Standard, undistorted fonts for the main title

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the pink outline is legible against the blue knit.
Check that the wave distortion doesn't make the text unreadable.
Verify the film grain is uniform across the image.
Confirm the metadata text is small and positioned at the extreme edges.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Top-down textured portrait] + [Vertically stretched wavy outline text] + [Film grain overlay] + [Edge-aligned technical metadata].
